home.title: Typed i18n. Real SSR. Clean Angular APIs.
home.lede: Etyma gives Angular teams typed JSON catalogs, MessageFormat 2, localized URLs, translated SSR HTML and hydration-safe lazy locale loading.
home.codeNote: Localized HTML ships from the server before hydration starts.
home.whyTitle: The i18n layer Angular apps should have by default.
home.featureTypedBody: The source catalog defines the key contract. Misspelled translation keys fail during TypeScript checks instead of becoming silent blank UI.
home.featureSsrBody: A localized URL renders localized HTML on the server, transfers the catalog, and hydrates without loading that locale again.
home.featureCloudBody: The Analog integration is tested through a Cloudflare Pages build so package output and runtime behavior stay honest.
home.workflowTitle: Define once. Route by URL. Hydrate without flicker.
home.workflowBody: Etyma keeps the source catalog typed, secondary catalogs lazy, and the visible page aligned with the address bar.
home.stepCatalogBody: JSON stays readable while TypeScript keeps the source locale as the contract.
home.stepRouteBody: The source locale remains clean, while secondary locales live under stable prefixes.
home.stepHydrateBody: SSR sends the catalog the page used, so hydration does not refetch it or flash English.
home.packagesTitle: One portable core, two Angular-facing adapters.
home.packagesBody: @etyma/core owns catalogs and MessageFormat. @etyma/angular exposes signals and transfer state. @etyma/analog connects URL routing, SSR and SEO.

docs.title: Install one i18n definition and let the URL choose the locale.
docs.lede: The source locale stays unprefixed. Secondary locales live under /es and /uk, and their catalogs are loaded only when a visitor asks for them.
docs.setupBody: Import the source catalog statically for typed keys and fallback. Keep secondary catalogs behind dynamic imports so they are split from the first bundle.
docs.routingBody: /docs is English, /es/docs is Spanish and /uk/docs is Ukrainian. Switching language preserves the page, query string and fragment.
docs.sourceOnly: This sentence exists only in the source catalog, so Spanish and Ukrainian fall back to it.

button.title: Signal-native Angular bindings without runtime ceremony.
button.lede: Components inject one typed i18n handle. Templates call t(), links call path(), and locale changes flow through Angular signals.
button.signalsBody: locale(), direction() and ready() are signals. The translation function reads them inside Angular templates and updates without Zone.js assumptions.
button.typesBody: Passing the i18n definition to injectI18n keeps keys typed across the package boundary without code generation.

themes.title: AnalogJS routing, SEO and SSR wired around localized URLs.
themes.lede: Etyma plugs into provideFileRouter(), loads the route locale before rendering, and maintains lang, dir, canonical and hreflang metadata.
themes.routingBody: There is no localStorage preference that can fight the address bar. /es/docs always means Spanish.
themes.seoBody: Each navigation updates html lang, dir, canonical, all hreflang alternates and x-default with absolute URLs.

footer.stack: Built with AnalogJS, Angular, Etyma and Lumen Icons.
